12. PUBLIC HEARINGS
A. Adoption of Resolutions and Introduction and First Reading of an Ordinance to adopt the Ocean Avenue Project Development Agreement
Recommended Action
It is recommended that the Council tak e the following actions:
1. Affirm that the Ocean Avenue Project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to Section 15182 of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Guidelines;
2. Adopt a resolution certi f ying the Final Environmental Impact Report (EIR) prepare d for the project in accordance with CEQA ;
3. Adopt a resolution adopting a Statement of Overriding Considerations to support approval of the Development Agreement based upon the Final EIR and other i n formation provided in the record and adopting a Mitigati on Monitoring and Reporting Program;
4. Adopt a resolution amending the 1992 Local Coastal Program Land Use Plan (LUP) for consistency with the 2010 General Plan and 2017 Downtown Community Plan standar d s for the project site; and
5. Introduce an ordinance for f irst reading to adopt Development Agreement 13DEV-004 for the Ocean Avenue Project.

16. COUNCILMEMBER DISCUSSION ITEMS
A. Request of Mayor Himmelrich that the City Council allocate the $29,000 of annual BID funding and $18,000 of Discretionary Funds previously discussed at their May 24, 2022 Budget Study Session. The funds include $10,000 to the Westside Coalition for their annual Martin Luther King Jr. Celebration, $5,000 to the Santa Monica Little League to repair the scoreboard at Los Amigos Park and $3,000 to Samohi for their bilingual graduation celebration. The motion to officially allocate the funds was inadvertently left off of the agenda for the June 28, 2022 Council meeting where the FY 22-23 budget was adopted.
